summary: Written by the data agent at build time, pending a real judge. Nine of the AKC's 2025 top 10 are household names; the German Shorthaired Pointer is the stretch, and Husky, Pug and Chihuahua are the famous misses.
reasons: Casual found Lab, Golden, German Shepherd, French Bulldog, Poodle, Beagle, Rottweiler and Dachshund, then lost lives on Husky, Chihuahua, Pug, Corgi (#10 in 2019) and Boxer (#6 in 2008).
The AKC's ranks past 10 aren't on Wikipedia, so most misses show no figure; breeds from its 2006-2008 and 2019-2024 top 10s show their last rank.
Every FCI and AKC breed costs a life; crossbreeds (labradoodle, goldendoodle) and pit bulls are free, and "labradoodle" is never read as Labrador. Ranked only, so not a Blitz.
